corpus: the 12 toy-triage fixtures, which share one instruction shape
what: Does carrying state across environments buy anything measurable?
design: The semantic gate is settled by the task text, not the verifier. Auditor.shape() keys on ecosystem plus the sorted instruction set and deliberately NOT on the manifest digest: the twelve toy-triage fixtures pair one ticket-classification prompt with twelve different planted defects, so keying on capabilities or version would defeat the point.
reading: 4 model calls become 1 and 31.4s becomes 2.9s, with every verdict identical. Only 4 of the 12 reach the gate at all -- it is consulted only when the battery flagged something in verifier_integrity, so a healthy environment costs nothing.
honesty: This is a cost result, not a capability result. Memory makes the same answer cheaper; it does not make a better one. A cached conclusion is reported with carried_from naming the environment it was reached on, so no card claims a judgement it did not get.
